What is the Silver HMO copay percentage?
The Silver HMO has a 20% copay percentage in the available plan information.

What is the Bronze HMO deductible?
The Bronze HMO has an annual deductible of $1,000. A deductible is the amount you generally pay toward covered services before the plan begins paying according to its terms.

My claim says Pending. Does that mean I owe the claim amount now?

A Pending status alone does not establish that you currently owe the claim amount. The available claim information only shows the status and listed amount. Contact support for billing or payment details.
